name: 01-narration
title: Plain narration
instructions: Calm, warm audiobook narrator. Unhurried pace.
input: The lighthouse keeper had not spoken to anyone in eleven days. Every morning he climbed the hundred and twelve steps, wiped the salt from the glass, and wrote the same three words in his logbook: wind from west. On the twelfth morning, there was a boat on the horizon, and it was heading straight for him.

name: 03-news
title: News anchor
instructions: Professional evening news anchor. Clear, confident, measured.
input: Good evening. Officials confirmed today that the city's new tram line will open three months ahead of schedule. The twelve kilometre route connects the airport to the central station, and is expected to carry around forty thousand passengers a day. Construction crews worked overnight shifts for most of the summer to finish the final section.

name: 02-casual
title: Casual, like a real person talking
instructions: Relaxed and casual, like telling a friend a story over coffee. Natural hesitations.
input: Okay so, um, I finally tried that new ramen place downtown? And honestly... it was fine. Like, the broth was really good, I'll give them that. But I waited forty minutes for a table, and then the guy next to me knocked my drink over, so. Yeah. I don't know. Maybe I'll go back. Probably not though.

name: 09-technical
title: Hard text: numbers, code, acronyms
instructions: Developer explaining something to a colleague. Natural, not robotic.
input: Run npm install, then open localhost:3000. If you get a 404, check that NODE_ENV is set to development. The API costs $0.50 per million tokens, and the release on 29/10/2026 bumped it to v3.8.1. Oh, and the SQL query takes about 1.2ms, which is fine.

name: 10-tongue-twister
title: Speed: tongue twister
instructions: Say it quickly and cleanly, slightly showing off.
input: Six sticky skeletons sat silently sorting sixty-six slippery sardines, while a proper copper coffee pot perked perfectly on the stove.

name: 04-sad
title: Emotional: grief
instructions: Quiet and grieving, voice close to breaking, slow with long pauses.
input: I kept his jacket on the hook by the door. I know that sounds silly. It's been two years. But every time I walk past it, for just a second, I think he's home. And then I remember. And I leave it there anyway.

name: 07-whisper
title: Whisper / bedtime story
instructions: Soft whisper, like reading a bedtime story to a child who is almost asleep.
input: And the little fox curled up under the old oak tree, tucked her nose under her tail, and listened to the rain. Pitter, patter, pitter, patter. The forest was quiet now. Everyone was safe. And slowly, slowly, her eyes closed.

name: 08-laugh
title: Laughing while talking
instructions: Can barely get the words out from laughing. Genuine giggles between phrases.
input: So he walks into the meeting, right, fully confident, starts presenting, and he's still got the cat filter on. The whole time. Twenty minutes. A little cat. Talking about quarterly revenue. And nobody said anything!

name: 06-angry
title: Emotional: anger
instructions: Frustrated customer on the phone, getting angrier with each sentence but trying to stay polite.
input: No, I understand that. I do. But this is the fourth time I've called this week. Fourth. Every single time someone tells me it'll be fixed in twenty four hours, and every single time, nothing happens. So I'm not asking you to open another ticket. I'm asking to speak to someone who can actually fix it.

name: 05-hype

instructions: Live football commentator losing his mind with excitement, fast and loud, rising to a shout.
input: He picks it up at halfway, past one, past two, he's still going! Thirty seconds left on the clock! He shoots! It's in! It's in! I cannot believe what we have just seen here tonight! Absolutely unbelievable!

name: 11-dialogue
title: Two speakers: podcast
instructions: Relaxed podcast conversation between two friends.

input.text: So, have you actually switched to the new phone yet?
I have. And I hate to say it, but the battery is incredible. I charged it on Sunday.
I know. I'm not even sorry.
Okay, that's it, I'm buying one tomorrow.
